Name: Gus Says Fabsol's Commissions
Author: grubbb
Description:
WARNING!: This replaces gus's normal text, i recommend creating a backup of the original Gus.xnb file first

Makes gus say Fabsol's (one of the creators of calamity) weird art commissions. only english language.


How To Install:
1. Find your stardew valley game folder
2. go to Content/Characters/Dialogue
3. drop the Gus.xnb file in there
4. this will replace the old file
5. enjoy
